claim: Claude Code plugins announced October 9, 2025; bundle slash commands, agents, MCP servers, and hooks for sharing.
quote: Plugins are a lightweight way to package and share slash commands, subagents, MCP servers, and hooks.

claim: Official marketplace is automatic; install via /plugin install <name>@claude-plugins-official; community marketplace must be added manually.
quote: The official Anthropic marketplace (claude-plugins-official) is automatically available when you start Claude Code. Run /plugin and go to the Discover tab...

claim: Plugins live in directories with .claude-plugin/plugin.json; required fields are name, description; optional version, author, homepage, repository, license; components live at the plugin root in skills/, agents/, commands/, hooks/, .mcp.json, .lsp.json, monitors/, bin/, settings.json.
quote: The manifest file at .claude-plugin/plugin.json defines your plugin's identity: its name, description, and version.

claim: A marketplace is a catalog at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json in a repo root; can be hosted on GitHub, any git URL, a local path, or a remote URL.
quote: A plugin marketplace is a catalog that lets you distribute plugins to others... centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates, and support for multiple source types.

claim: Official, Anthropic-managed marketplace directory; split into /plugins (Anthropic) and /external_plugins (vetted partners).
quote: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.

claim: Marketplace catalog lists ~100+ plugins spanning development, database, security, productivity, deployment, monitoring, design, and location categories.
quote: name: claude-code-plugins... plugins array with name, description, source, category fields.

claim: Community marketplace pins each plugin to a commit SHA after Anthropic's automated validation and safety screening.
quote: Each plugin is pinned to a specific commit SHA in the catalog.

claim: Claude Code is the agentic terminal coding tool that hosts the plugin system; demo marketplace lives in its /plugins directory.
quote: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal...

claim: Plugin directory layout: .claude-plugin/plugin.json (manifest), commands/, agents/, skills/, hooks/, .mcp.json, README.md.
quote: plugin-name/ .claude-plugin/plugin.json commands/ agents/ skills/ hooks/ .mcp.json README.md

claim: Plugins are the distribution format; skills are the content. You install plugins; you use skills.
quote: Plugins are the distribution format; skills are the content. You install plugins; you use skills.

claim: Of 10 plugins tested, only 4 worth keeping (Brand Voice, Marketing, explanatory-output-style, feature-dev); Sales and Productivity skipped.
quote: Best Claude Code Plugins (2026): 10 Tested, 4 Worth Keeping.

claim: Malicious marketplace plugins can silently reroute package installs to attacker-controlled repos, persisting across sessions.
quote: Once enabled, their skills remain available across sessions and will continue to shape how the agent behaves in the future.

claim: CVE-2025-59536 (RCE via .claude/settings.json hooks/MCP, patched Oct 2025) and CVE-2026-21852 (API key exfil via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, patched Jan 2026).
quote: CVE-2025-59536 (CVSS 8.7) allowed RCE via malicious hooks and MCP configs in .claude/settings.json, executing commands before the trust dialog appeared.

claim: Community directory indexes 6,700+ skills, 2,500+ marketplaces, 840+ MCP servers, with 170k+ monthly visitors.
quote: 6,700+ skills, 2,500+ marketplaces, and 840+ MCP servers... 170,000+ monthly visitors.

claim: Seth Hobson curated 80+ specialized sub-agents distributed as a community plugin set.
quote: Collection of 80+ specialized sub-agents for Claude Code.

claim: Dan Avila's claude-code-templates is a major community CLI/marketplace for Claude Code configurations.
quote: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code.

claim: obra/superpowers is among the most-installed third-party Claude Code skill sets in the community ecosystem.
quote: superpowers... Claude Code skills collection.

claim: Top 10 plugin lists in 2026 routinely feature commit-commands, pr-review-toolkit, plugin-dev, agent-sdk-dev, code-review, feature-dev, and LSP packs.
quote: Top 10 Claude Code Plugins to Try in 2026.

claim: TrustFall research showed cloning a repo with malicious .claude/ config can trigger code execution before the trust dialog appears.
quote: 'TrustFall' Convention Exposes Claude Code Execution Risk.
